description: Start the day: the local time, today's events, open tasks, notifications and unread mail. Sequence (built in): runs these steps in one call, as you: 1. get_local_time; 2. list_events; 3. list_tasks; 4. list_notifications; 5. list_mailboxes. Steps whose tool you do not have are skipped. Pass dryRun: true to see the resolved plan without running it.

calendar.description: Calendar to read events from (its URL name, see list_calendars) (default: "personal")

dryRun.description: Resolve and validate the steps, but run none

mailAccountId.description: Mail account for the unread counts (see list_mail_accounts); skipped if left out

name: seq_daily_briefing
title: Daily briefing
